{{Quote|We found Grarwwaar's body last night: what was left of it. If we do not leave the Shadowlands soon, I fear we will all become victims of the Faceless One.|The final entry of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warrior's datapad journal|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic" />}}
'''Rulan Prolik''' was a [[Rulan Prolik's species|polymorphic being]] who,<ref name="CSWE" /> by [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> was an [[Overseer (GenoHaradan)|Overseer]] of the secretive [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] guild known as the [[GenoHaradan]]. Another Overseer, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hulas]], plotted to kill<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic" /> him<ref name="CSWE" /> and other Overseers, which would make him the de facto leader of the GenoHaradan.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic" />

The identities of the four GenoHaradan overseers were meant to remain unknown even to each other, but Hulas managed to learn that Rulan was among the number. Hulas consequently attempted to enlist [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] him, claiming that Rulan was responsible for several prominent assassinations in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and would likely move to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], wreaking havoc in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] itself. 

At some point no earlier than 3956 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> Prolik was killed by a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] after impersonating Wookiees known to have disappeared in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]]<ref name="CSWE" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic" /> 

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Got something on your mind, do you?|Rulan Prolik impersonating Jolee Bindo|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic" />}}
Overseers of the GenoHaradan were mysterious by nature, but Rulan's [[Rulan Prolik's species|alien]] shapeshifting capabilities placed him in a separate league. Few knew his identity as an overseer; fewer knew his species, or even whether his power derived from natural ability or alien technology. His skill in assuming a target's identity was uncanny&mdash;to the extent of knowing exact phrases the target would say. Rulan could assassinate someone, assume that victim's identity, and convincingly maintain the identity for long durations of time. Stranger still, when he was killed, there was a blinding flash of light that left only a twisted, shrunken humanoid corpse.

Rulan's shapeshifting was no mere illusion; he would actually take on the physical characteristics of whomever or whatever he changed into. There was some level of restriction to this power, however: while he could use claws and other natural weapons of creatures he mimicked and even simple swords, he could not conjure up energy weapons his target might have used (such as a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]), and, even if his target was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], he could not replicate the target's connection with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Behind the scenes==
If the player accepts the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] quest, [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] kills Rulan at the behest of [[Hulas]]. He at first takes the form of a wookiee named [[Grarwwaar]]. Upon finding a datapad, Revan will discover that Grarwwaar is actually dead. Upon presenting this to Rulan, he will attack by first taking the form of [[Jolee Bindo]] and then a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]], but seeing that he was no match for Revan, the shapeshifter took the form of a harmless [[Tach/Legends|tach]] and hid among other tachs. In doing this, Rulan underestimated Revan's resolve: the fallen Jedi had no qualms with slaughtering all the tachs in the area until Rulan was discovered. Rulan died by Revan's hand and reverted to his natural form in a burst of light.

Also, there is data in the game files that suggests Prolik would take the form of any one of the player's companions, including the player, not only Jolee. This was left out of the final release, however.
